releaseNotes:
• Browser & App Theme: now dynamically follows phone's default theme (Day/Night Mode)
• System Language Integration: browser requests and webpages now match phone's default language
• Soft Keyboard Auto-Lift: window smoothly glides upward when typing so input field is never covered
• Unread Notification Red Dot: floating bubble shows a vibrant red dot badge when web apps receive notifications
• Real Brand Icons: bundled official icons for 50+ Web Apps even if not installed
